title: Mobile Support
features:
Main Combat Features

Auto Slap (Auto Clicker): can be toggled on and off via both a UI button and a  keybind (F by default).
Slap Delay Control: A slider to control the speed of the auto-slap.
Spam 'E' Key:  simulates the 'E' key being pressed to automatically use your default glove ability.

Player & Movement
Walk Speed: A slider to precisely adjust your character's movement speed.
Anti Ragdoll:  prevents you from being knocked down or ragdolled.
Safe Teleport: A feature with both a dedicated UI button and a keybind (B by default) that instantly teleports your character to a fixed, safe location on the map.

Utility
Badge Glove Unlocker: A button that unlocks all non-paid, badge-related gloves
